description: This file defines API routes for managing shopping cart operations in an e-commerce backend, including adding, deleting, and updating cart items, as well as decreasing product quantities.

methods.name: POST /add
methods.description: Adds a new cart with products after calculating sales tax and decreases product quantities.

methods.name: DELETE /delete/:cartId
methods.description: Deletes a cart by its ID.

methods.name: POST /add/:cartId
methods.description: Adds a product to an existing cart.

methods.name: DELETE /delete/:cartId/:productId
methods.description: Removes a specific product from a cart.
